schema.name: nx_sim_temperature
schema.description: Create a prescribed absolute-temperature constraint on distinct SIM face IDs from nx_sim_faces. temperature_k is finite and nonnegative Kelvin, not Celsius. Requires the active NX MULTIPHYSICS Thermal solution. Returns typed constraint/face references, committed temperature and native property readback; provenance is stored on the constraint. Nonempty name/provenance required; duplicate names rejected. Uses verified creation rollback; does not save or solve. Time-varying temperatures and automatic overconstraint analysis are not supported here. Supply operation_id for safe retry.

outputSchema.description: Structured success/error envelope with additive metadata. Tool-specific payload remains extensible.
